claim_boundary: Cycle C003 survivor entries. None is a proof, novelty claim, probability assessment, or evidence that P equals NP.

hypotheses.title: TC0-Frege Superpolynomial Lower-Bound Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exists an explicit polynomial-time constructible family {T_n} of propositional tautologies of size poly(n) such that every dag-like TC0-Frege proof of T_n has size n^{omega(1)}.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This would establish a superpolynomial lower bound for a proof system stronger than AC0[2]-Frege and would therefore also imply lower bounds for weaker bounded-depth Frege fragments. It would be a major proof-complexity advance but would not by itself settle P versus NP.
falsification_conditions: A polynomial p such that every tautology of length n has a TC0-Frege proof of size at most p(n).
Polynomial-size TC0-Frege proofs for the exact explicit family selected by any sharpened descendant.
attack_surface: bounded-depth and tree-like Frege lower bounds
candidate pigeonhole, parity, and random-CNF tautologies
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The cited sources motivate the frontier and establish lower bounds or hardness only for weaker, restricted, tree-like, or conditional settings. No explicit hard family for full dag-like TC0-Frege is supplied here.

hypotheses.title: Polynomially Bounded TC0-Frege Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exists a polynomial p such that every propositional tautology of encoding length n has a dag-like TC0-Frege proof of size at most p(n).
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: TC0-Frege would be a polynomially bounded Cook-Reckhow proof system, implying NP = coNP. This hypothesis is mutually incompatible with H012.
falsification_conditions: An explicit polynomial-time constructible tautology family requiring n^{omega(1)} TC0-Frege proof size.
Any unconditional theorem implying that no polynomially bounded TC0-Frege system exists.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Conditional or search-hardness results do not refute polynomial proof existence. OPEN does not express confidence and H013 cannot be simultaneously true with H012.

hypotheses.title: Polynomially Bounded Full IPS for Boolean CNF over GF(2) Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exists a polynomial p such that every unsatisfiable CNF formula F has a full Ideal Proof System refutation over GF(2), for the standard Boolean polynomial encoding of F, whose algebraic-circuit size is at most p(|F|).
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This would establish polynomial boundedness of full IPS for Boolean CNF instances and would refute H007. It would not by itself yield a deterministic polynomial-time SAT algorithm because proof search and deterministic polynomial identity testing remain separate obligations.
falsification_conditions: An explicit Boolean CNF family requiring n^{omega(1)} algebraic-circuit size in unrestricted full IPS over GF(2).
A theorem transferring a superpolynomial algebraic-circuit lower bound to full IPS refutations of an explicit Boolean CNF family.
attack_surface: multilinear and constant-depth IPS lower bounds
polynomial identity testing and proof verification
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Known cited lower bounds apply to restricted IPS fragments or conditional templates. H014 concerns proof existence only and is mutually incompatible with H007.

hypotheses.title: Unconditional Weak Non-Automatability of TC0-Frege Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There is no deterministic algorithm that, given an unsatisfiable CNF F and a unary bound 1^s, always outputs a TC0-Frege refutation of F in time polynomial in |F|+s whenever F has a TC0-Frege refutation of size at most s.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This would separate the existence of short TC0-Frege proofs from efficient proof search by an unconditional theorem. It would constrain proof-search routes to P = NP but would not itself resolve proof-size lower bounds.
falsification_conditions: A deterministic weak automatizer for TC0-Frege with running time polynomial in the formula size and promised proof-size bound.
An unconditional theorem deriving such an automatizer from the syntax or semantics of TC0-Frege.
attack_surface: promise handling and proof verification cost
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The cited results are conditional or cover fixed-depth Frege automation. They motivate but do not prove the unconditional TC0-Frege statement.

hypotheses.title: Bounded-Radius Definitional d-DNNF Compiler Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exist constants r and k and a finite ordered grammar G of local transformations such that each transformation inspects at most r clauses, variables, and circuit gates; introduces at most r fresh variables constrained by fan-in-two Tseitin definitions; and carries an exhaustive truth-table certificate over at most r boundary variables. Applied canonically for at most N^k steps to any CNF F of length N, G outputs a d-DNNF circuit D of size at most N^k whose existential projection onto the original variables is equivalent to F, and from every satisfying trace of D a satisfying assignment of F is recoverable in time N^k.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Satisfiability of the resulting d-DNNF is decidable in linear time, so the fixed compiler would decide CNF-SAT in polynomial time and imply P = NP.
falsification_conditions: A theorem proving that every finite bounded-radius definitional grammar of the stated form requires superpolynomial output or fails on an explicit CNF family.
For any concrete grammar G, a finite or infinite counterexample violating local equivalence, determinism, decomposability, size, termination, projection equivalence, or witness recovery.
attack_surface: exponential DNNF and SDD lower bounds
auxiliary variables followed by existential projection
global structure generated by local certified rewrites
hypotheses.claim_boundary: An unrestricted polynomial-time compiler would be circular by solve-and-encode. H016 forbids that route by fixing a finite bounded-radius grammar with constant-size semantic certificates. No such grammar is known.

hypotheses.title: Parity-Core Separator Compiler Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exist constants r, c, and k and a fixed deterministic compiler P that uses only: bounded-radius truth-table-certified CNF rewrites; recognition of explicit bounded-fan-in XOR gate templates; introduction of fan-in-two XOR extension variables; Gaussian elimination on the explicitly derived affine subsystem; substitution of certified affine consequences; and polynomially many locally certified Tseitin rewrites. For every CNF F of length N, P halts in N^k steps with an equisatisfiable CNF F_P of size N^k and primal treewidth at most c log N, with polynomial-time recovery of an assignment of F.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Gaussian elimination plus bounded-treewidth dynamic programming would give a deterministic polynomial-time SAT algorithm, implying P = NP.
falsification_conditions: An explicit family on which every compiler restricted to the stated parity extraction and local rewrite operations leaves primal treewidth omega(log N) or incurs superpolynomial size.
For any concrete compiler, a counterexample to the affine certificate, equisatisfiability, termination, width bound, or witness recovery.
attack_surface: random 3-CNF formulas with no obvious XOR templates
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The hypothesis does not assume a parity oracle: every affine equation must be produced by explicit templates and checkable algebra. Existing parity proof lower bounds do not yet quantify over this exact compiler model.

hypotheses.title: Bounded-Interface Exact Residual Quotient Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exist constants b and k and a fixed deterministic algorithm Q that explores partial assignments of any CNF F of length N while merging residual formulas only when it produces a polynomial-time checkable equivalence certificate composed of variable renaming, invertible affine substitutions over GF(2), and fan-in-two definitional extensions whose exposed interface contains at most b log N variables. At every assignment depth the number of certified residual equivalence classes is at most N^k, canonical representatives and certificates are computed in N^k total time, and a satisfying assignment is recoverable from any accepting quotient path.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: The quotient search DAG would contain polynomially many states and decide CNF-SAT in polynomial time, implying P = NP.
falsification_conditions: An explicit CNF family forcing superpolynomially many inequivalent residual classes under the exact certificate language and logarithmic-interface bound.
A lower bound showing that canonicalization or certificate verification in the stated equivalence language must be superpolynomial on an explicit family.
attack_surface: OBDD, FBDD, SDD, and d-DNNF size lower bounds
hidden weighted bit and communication-complexity functions
residual diversity on expander and random formulas
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The equivalence relation is richer than ordinary variable-order residual equality but is still explicitly bounded and certificate based. No polynomial quotient-width theorem or counterexample for this exact language is known.

hypotheses.title: Local Proof-Carrying Variable Elimination Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exist constants r, c, and k and a finite set E of variable-elimination templates. Each template replaces all occurrences of one selected variable together with at most r locally introduced definitional variables by a hash-consed Boolean interface DAG over the remaining boundary variables, and includes a truth-table or algebraic certificate involving at most r boundary symbols that verifies exact existential equivalence. A fixed canonical scheduler applies E to every CNF F of length N, producing at most N^k distinct interface nodes, never exposing more than c log N boundary symbols per interface, and deciding whether the final constant interface is true while preserving a polynomial-time witness reconstruction trace.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: The proof-carrying elimination process would decide CNF-SAT in polynomial time and imply P = NP.
falsification_conditions: A theorem that every finite locally certified elimination-template set must create either superpolynomially many interface nodes or an omega(log N) exposed boundary on an explicit CNF family.
For a proposed template set, a counterexample to exact existential equivalence, node bound, interface bound, scheduling termination, or witness reconstruction.
attack_surface: DNNF and SDD compilation lower bounds
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Hash-consing alone cannot defeat exponential semantic diversity. H019 survives only because existing direct compilation lower bounds have not been shown to cover this exact finite, local, proof-carrying extension language.
